Winning by a nose can pay fifty times more than second place.

Kevin Trudeau describes two horses coming down the finish line. One wins by a nose, and that horse collects far more than the one right behind it.

The winner did not win by fifty times more. It won by an inch and got paid like it was fifty times better.

Kevin says that is what luck is: a tiny edge that changes the whole result.

Where in your life would a small edge change everything?

#ad #luck #success #money

A DNA experiment Kevin says shows everything is connected.

Kevin Trudeau describes research he believes was done by the US Army. A person's DNA was placed in a petri dish while the person watched disturbing images of war.

The researchers noticed the DNA in the person's body contracted. The DNA in the dish contracted too, even though it was not connected to the body.

Kevin presents this as support for the theory that everything is connected.

What do you make of an idea like that?

#ad #mind #mindset #kevintrudeau

Two prizes went to someone else. He stood up anyway.

Kevin Trudeau remembers a raffle where three prizes were being drawn. The first two names were not his.

As the third was about to be drawn, he stood up and started walking toward the stage. Then his name was called. He says he saw it so clearly that he already knew.

Kevin says that was the moment he knew you can change your luck.

When did you last feel completely sure of yourself?

#ad #luck #confidence #kevintrudeau
